name: Tirupati Starch and Chemicals Limited
about: Tirupati Starch and Chemicals Limited manufactures and sells starch, dextrose anhydrous, liquid glucose, and other products in India. The company offers maize starch powder, dextrose monohydrate, modified starch, white and yellow dextrin, hydrol, grit, IP starch, husk, and corn gluten and gem products. It serves food, poultry, paper, textiles, pharma and cosmetics, automobiles, and bioplastic industries. The company also exports its products. Tirupati Starch and Chemicals Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Dhar, India.
